plate_comment: The 48RE anti-hunt governor pressure mode (e2m RE_AH_* / RE_Hold_Curve_* / RE_PSA_Max_*). In 1st / 2nd gear it holds the governor pressure on the hold curve against the throttle, which prevents the upshift (pressure states 0x14 / 0x15). When the predicted post-shift acceleration is above the minimum for the throttle (cm848_predictPostShiftAcceleration) and the anti-hunt delay has run out, it forces the upshift with the boost curve against the output shaft speed (0x12 / 0x13) and keeps it for the boost time after the new gear is identified. After a forced 1-2 upshift it learns the vehicle inertia (cm848_learnVehicleInertia). In 3rd gear a high enough prediction sets bit 2 of protection_condition_flags_t_0040b0e8.condition_eval (the 3-4 upshift is the overdrive solenoid's) (was cm848_processProtectionStateFlags)

Predicts the output shaft acceleration after an upshift: the road load (current gear torque - inertia x acceleration) taken from the next gear's torque, divided by the learned vehicle inertia (transmission_predicted_post_shift_acceleration). Runs only while the output shaft is not decelerating (was cm848_protectionRateOfChangeCalculation)

The transmission output torque in a gear (the parameter: gear + 1 = the current gear) at the current output speed and throttle: turbine speed = output speed x the gear ratio, the turbine torque from the prescaled throttle and turbine speed (e2m RE_TPS_3DSCL / RE_Turbine_3DSCL / RE_Torque_Input), times the gear ratio (was cm848_protectionScaledLimitCalculation)

After a forced 1-2 upshift, above transmission_vehicle_inertia_learning_minimum_throttle: measures the vehicle inertia as the output torque change x 64 / the output shaft acceleration change across the shift, and keeps it as transmission_vehicle_inertia when the change is large enough and the value is within the minimum / maximum (e2m RE_Inertia) (was cm848_calculateProtectionFuelDemandThreshold)
